title: Thai Squid Curry
description: A spicy Thai-inspired curry made with succulent squid and a blend of aromatic spices. Serve over steamed jasmine rice for a complete meal.

ingredients.name: Squid
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the squid and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the fish sauce, brown sugar, and 1 cup of water to the skillet.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the squid is cooked through.
Stir in the Thai basil and lime juice.
Serve hot over steamed jasmine rice.
